title: Toyota Motor Corporation: SOUTHEAST TOYOTA/TIRES (19 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH CONTINENTAL TOURING TIRES, P205-65R15 92S,  INSTALLED AT THE PORTS IN JACKSONVILLE, FLORIDA.  THE INCORRECT TIRES WERE INSTALLED ON VEHICLES THAT HAD DAMAGED TIRES.  THE TIRES WERE DAMAGED DURING A PORT UPGRADE TO ALUMINUM WHEELS.

title: CHANCE COACH, INC.: CHANCE COACH/TRANSMISSION DIPSTICKS (45 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  TRANSIT COACHES.  THE TRANSMISSION DIPSTICKS ARE TOO LONG.

title: Brenner Tank, LLC: BRENNER/FMVSS 121/BENDIX ABS ECU (16 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  TRAILERS EQUIPPED WITH BENDIX ANTILOCK BRAKE SYSTEM (ABS) ELECTRONIC CONTROL MODULE (ECU).   THE ABS ON THESE VEHICLES DOES NOT CONTAIN THE INDUSTRY STANDARD POWER LINE CARRIER (PLC) CHIP REQUIRED TO PROVIDE AN ABS MALFUNCTION SIGNAL TO THE TOWING VEHICLE AS REQUIRED BY FMVSS NO. 121, "AIR BRAKE SYSTEMS."

title: SAAB CARS USA, INC.: SAAB/TIE ROD END RETAINING NUTS (1,366 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:    PASSENGER VEHICLES.  THE TIE ROD END RETAINING NUTS MAY NOT HAVE BEEN PROPERLY TIGHTENED AT THE FACTORY.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: INTERNATIONAL/LIGHTS (13,492 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  HEAVY DUTY TRUCKS.  THESE VEHICLES COULD EXPERIENCE A LOSS OF THE LOW BEAM HEADLIGHTS, THE HIGH BEAM HEADLIGHTS, OR BOTH.   A SOFTWARE PROBLEM WITHIN THE ELECTRICAL SYSTEM CONTROLLER (ESC) CAN CAUSE THE CIRCUIT FOR THE LOW BEAM OR THE CIRCUIT FOR THE HIGH BEAM HEADLIGHTS TO FUSE OR OPEN, RESULTING IN LOSS OF EITHER THE LOW OR HIGH BEAM HEADLIGHTS OR POSSIBLY EVEN BOTH.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: BLUE BIRD/FMVSS 225/TETHER ANCHORAGE (19 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  CERTAIN 10,000 LB. GVWR NON-SCHOOL BUSES WITH CHASSIS FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 225 "CHILD RESTRAINT ANCHORAGE SYSTEMS."  THESE VEHICLES WERE MANUFACTURED WITHOUT AN UPPER TETHER ANCHORAGE AS REQUIRED BY THE STANDARD.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/AUTOLIV/AIRBAG INFLATORS (911 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES THAT HAVE HAD THE DRIVER'S AIR BAG MODULE REPLACED AFTER APRIL 5, 2000.  THE REPLACEMENT DRIVER'S AIR BAG MODULE INFLATOR MAY HAVE INSUFFICIENT WELDS THAT COULD PREVENT PROPER INFLATION OF THE AIR BAG.

title: Ferrari North America, Inc.: FERRARI/OIL FILTERS (2,790 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  REPLACEMENT OIL FILTERS (FERRARI PART NO. 111782), MANUFACTURED BETWEEN MAY 31, 2000, AND MAY 31, 2001.  SOME OF THESE OIL FILTERS WITH THIS PART NUMBER WERE MADE IN A DIFFERENT MANNER FROM THE PERVIOUS VERSION.  AS A RESULT, THE OIL FILTER MAY LEAK ENGINE OIL FROM THE SEAL RING AREA.  THESE OIL FILTERS CAN BE USED ON FERRARI MODEL VEHICLES DATING BACK TO THE 1960S.  THE MODEL VEHICLES THESE FILTERS CAN BE USED ON ARE:  DINO 206 GT, DINO 246 GT/GTS, DINO 308 GT4, 208 GTB/GTS TURBO, 208 GT4, 208 GTB/GTS TURBO INTERCOOLER, GTB/GTS TURBO, 275 GTB4, 308 GT4, 308 GTB/GTS, 308I GTB/GTS, 328 GTB/GTS, 330 GT, 330 GTC, 365 GT, 365 GT4, 365 GT4BB, 365 GTC (1970), 365 GTC/GTS, 365 GTC4, 365 GTS4, 400I GT/GTA, 4000 GT/GTA, 412 GT/GTA, 512BB, 512I BB, MONDIAL 3.2, MONDIAL 3.2 CABRIOLET, MONDIAL 8, MONDIAL 9 CABRIOLET, MONDIAL 4V, 288 GTO.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): DAIMLERCHRYSLER/FMVSS 225/OWNER MANUAL INFO (52,649 affected)

title: CPSC, Biddeford Textile Corp. Announce Recall of Electric Blankets
summary: The plug that connects the detachable control switch to the blanket can become loose. The resulting poor electrical contacts can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 394,000.

title: CPSC, Compaq Announce Recall of Notebook Computer AC Adapters
summary: These AC adapters can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: More than 1.4 million.

title: CPSC, American Water Heater Co. Announce Recall to Replace Burners in Gas Water Heaters
summary: The burners could produce excess carbon monoxide (CO), posing a risk of CO poisoning to consumers. Units: About 16,000.

title: CPSC, National Presto Industries Inc. Announce Recall of Deep Fryer Basket Handles
summary: The handles on the fryer baskets can come off, resulting in hot oil spattering the user and bystanders. Units: About 50,000.

title: CPSC, Norcold Inc. Announce Recall of Refrigerators
summary: Tubing in the cooling unit can crack and leak flammable gas, presenting a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: 360.

title: CPSC, Wolf Range Co. Inc. and Wolf Appliance Co. LLC Announce Recall of Gas Ranges
summary: Delayed ignition of gas in the ovens and broilers can put consumers at risk of burn injuries and fires. Units: About 15,000.

title: CPSC, Cisco Announce Recall of Power Adapters
summary: The adapters can overheat and melt a hole through the housing, posing a fire hazard. In addition, the exposed wires pose a shock hazard. Units: About 95,000.

title: CPSC, Whirlpool Announce Recall of Microwave-Hood Combinations
summary: These units can overheat and catch fire. Units: About 1.8 million.

title: CPSC, Endar Corp. Announce Recall of Candle Sets Sold in Wal-Mart Stores
summary: The wax from the candles can drip and ignite the potpourri. Additionally, when the candles are in close proximity, they generate a significant amount of heat. Each of these hazards could lead to a fire, which could cause burn injuries to consumers. Units: 74,000.

title: CPSC, Oriental Trading Company Announce Recall of Coconut Bamboo Torches
summary: When the torch container is filled with oil, the oil may spill and burn a consumer if the torch is used improperly, moved or jostled during use. Units: Approximately 1,180.

title: CPSC, Palliser Furniture Ltd. Announce Recall of Toy Boxes
summary: The toy box's lid can fall suddenly, posing entrapment and strangulation hazards to young children. In addition, spaces at the end of the hinge on the lid can cause pinched, crushed and lacerated fingers. The toy chest voluntary standard requires toy boxes or chests with hinged lids to have lid supp

title: CPSC, Dorel Juvenile Group Announce Recall of Cosco Playpens
summary: The plastic tabs on the playpen that lock the rails into the corners can break or loosen over time, allowing the rails to turn inward, collapse and entrap an infant. Units: About 102,000.

title: CPSC, Evenflo Announce Recall to Repair Home Décor Swing™ Wooden Baby Gates
summary: The plastic mounting hardware that attaches to the wall can crack or break, allowing the wooden gate to unlatch. Children can then gain access to restricted areas, such as stairs. Also, the plastic hardware attached to the side of the gate can break, creating small parts that pose a choking hazard t

title: CPSC, Little Tikes Announce Recall of Swings
summary: The buckles on the swing can break and the shoulder restraint straps can pull out of the back of the seat, causing young children to fall. Units: About 250,000.

title: CPSC, Safety 1st Announce Recall of Fold-Up Booster Seats
summary: The top half of the seat inserts can separate, and a child can fall from the chair and be injured. Units: About 1.5 million.

title: CPSC, Wysco Inc. Announce Recall of "Runt"™ Mini-Bicycles
summary: These bicycles do not have any brakes, which are required by the CPSC standard for bicycles of this type. The CPSC standard also requires that these bicycles have chain guards, to prevent riders from getting fingers, toes and clothing caught in the gears. Units: About 95,000.

title: CPSC, Salsa Cycles Announce Recall of Bicycle Rims
summary: The rims can unexpectedly fail during normal use, posing the risk of falls and serious injury to riders. Units: About 500.

title: CPSC, Emess Lighting Inc. and SLI Lighting Solutions Inc. Announce Recall to Repair Twister Portable Lamps
summary: The lamp's bulb can become hot, presenting a risk of burn injuries to consumers, and the risk of fire if the bulb comes in contact with combustible materials. Units: About 480,000.

title: CPSC, Sassy Inc. Announce Recall to Replace Rattles
summary: The sewn-on spherical-shaped fabric eyes on the rattles can detach, posing a choking hazard to small children. Units: About 455,000.

title: CPSC, Discovery Toys Announce Recall of Children's Toy Phones
summary: The blue, hard plastic antenna ball can break off the toy phone, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 57,000.
